Iluvien (fluocinolone implant) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-382212  
Guideline Name 
Iluvien (fluocinolone implant)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Iluvien  
Diagnosis 
Uveitis  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming ONE of the following 
diagnoses:  
• 
Intermediate uveitis  
• 
Posterior uveitis  


--- PDF page 856 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 856 
• 
Panuveitis  
 
AND 
 
2 - Inflammation is chronic  
 
AND 
 
3 - Inflammation is NOT due to an infection  
 
Product Name:Iluvien  
Diagnosis 
Diabetic Macular Edema  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of diabetic 
macular edema  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has previously been treated with a course of corticosteroids  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has NOT had a clinically significant rise in intraocular pressure  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes
